name: Water held in anguish

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The next souls are water spirits around Coilskar, where the quest says Illidari naga control the valley’s only clean water. This branch of the task ties elemental pain to a present pressure on the land: a living supply has been taken and its spirits cry out. The water’s exact source and course are not drawn here. The story keeps its attention on the named place and the souls Torlok asks the adventurer to gather.
